new_canonical_source.dimension_policy: read DDS header; do not trust _WIDTHxHEIGHT suffix

migration_rules: Match assets by stable hexadecimal hash prefix, not the old resolution suffix.
Use the user-supplied OR2-HD-GUI package as the graphics baseline.
Keep completed HD artwork unchanged except exact text cells required for Korean localization.
Treat upstream placeholder-upscale assets as low-resolution source content and rebuild them.
Create new HD Korean artwork for stock-resolution text graphics D6DC1380 and 48DEBE77.
Keep 6B8ED9DA in the Hangul font pipeline rather than generic graphics repaint.
Preserve alpha, DDS behavior, sprite orientation, cell geometry, non-text pixels and original bounds.
Do not upscale prior stock-resolution Korean candidates.
